q: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul says to rejoice how often?
In 1 Thessalonians, Paul says to pray how?
In 1 Thessalonians, in what circumstances should we give thanks?
why: This is God's will for you.
quote: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, the Day of the Lord will come like what?
quote: the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, where will believers meet the Lord when He comes?
why: We will always be with the Lord.
quote: to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul tells believers to encourage and do what to one another?
quote: Therefore encourage and build one another up

q: In 1 Thessalonians, after describing the Lord's coming, what does Paul say to do with these words?
quote: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, after testing all things, what should you hold fast to?
quote: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, why did Paul write about those who sleep in death?
quote: so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, who will rise first when the Lord descends?
why: Then the living will be caught up.
quote: and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, which instrument of God will sound when the Lord descends?
why: With the voice of an archangel.
quote: and with the trumpet of God

q: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul says he was gentle among them like whom?
quote: we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.

q: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul remembers their work of faith and labor of what?
quote: your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope

q: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul urges believers to work with their own what?
quote: and to work with your own hands

q: In 1 Thessalonians, from what should believers abstain?
quote: Abstain from every form of evil.

q: Besides Paul and Timothy, who sent 1 Thessalonians?
quote: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians

q: In 1 Thessalonians, whom did Paul send to strengthen the believers' faith?
quote: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God

q: In 1 Thessalonians, whose voice will be heard when the Lord descends?
quote: with the voice of an archangel

q: In 1 Thessalonians, Paul urges believers to aspire to live how?
quote: and to aspire to live quietly
